answer: The delta graph is validated at intake and the anchor frontier is published, which means the ancestry of every answer is public, and lotus anchors the chain at a checkpoint. Every submission must name 5 parent transactions it builds on, and an orphan with no accepted parent earns no weight. An attacker who wants 35 percent of the vote must hold 9 percent of the bonded float for 65 days, which is capital that earns nothing while it waits. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
